important_checks: Uninterrupted training equals interruption/resume for exact weights, optimizer, Python/NumPy/Torch RNG, loader generators, history and fixed target.
Resume-best restores epoch1 full state although latest is epoch3.
Approved source migration preserves weights with new optimizer and epoch0; fresh ignores source/search checkpoints.
Corrupt newest checkpoint recovers a verified older state; missing, incompatible or wholly corrupt states never silently start fresh.
Private real baseline survives restart; uncertain speed/keypoint references are excluded from reported denominators.
LCD value changes, nonbinary masks, normalized-coordinate mismatch and source-plate split leakage are rejected.
Shifted predicted pivot and projective registration recover an interior58km/h fixture without oracle camera transforms.
ZIP traversal, backslash paths, symlinks, case-fold duplicates and changed extraction caches reject.
Fixed endpoint tolerance accepts only within2km/h beyond0/180 with explicit raw speed and clamp flag; wider excursions reject, exact endpoints and interior speeds remain unchanged.
limitations: Small software fixtures test state handling and input contracts; they do not estimate neural-network accuracy.
No long model training or real-world independent testing was performed by this suite.
